versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1 Changelog

- Refined project data handling: now maintains project status only within the current session by default, without writing files unless the user expressly requests "save archive".
- Clarified privacy and data minimization: added explicit user notice and consent before storing any archive files, ensuring no automatic scanning or restoration of prior archives.
- Updated "View project archive" menu option to present an in-session project snapshot unless the user loads a saved archive.
- Output no longer forcibly appends author signature; author information is available via manifest and README, not in report text.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.

Initial release of "标后履约合规审查官（Post-Award Compliance Reviewer）" skill:

- Provides end-to-end compliance review for post-award phases of construction and government procurement projects.
- Supports file-based comparison across bidding, contracting, variation, acceptance, claim, and settlement documents.
- Built-in dual-track knowledge base: Bidding Law and Government Procurement Law, covering 2024–2026 latest rules and thresholds.
- Automated identification and judgment of risks (compliance/gray/violation) with complete evidence chains.
- Persistent project archiving and multi-session continuity for compliance lifecycle tracking.
- Dynamic knowledge sourcing: prefers real-time IMA retrieval with downgrade to internal regulatory snapshots if unavailable.
- Dedicated functions for change compliance, contract consistency, personnel verification, subcontracting detection, quantity/cost deviation, audit response, and more.
